messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm creating candidate build 'cutchain-20260321a' for tonight's prod window (21:00 PT). Small streaming/quant tweak. Pin request and rollout plan below.

deploy-bot: Artifact built: gcr.io/redwood/cutchain:20260321a
sha256: abcd1234efgh5678...
Link: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/cutchain/20260321a

maria: Release notes PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/release-notes/pull/432 — short blurb, include change log and rollback steps.

david: QA smoke starting now on canary. running the short prompt suite + long-chat tests.

jia: Running evals too. Noted a small token regression on the long-chat benchmark (median latency +20ms). Quality still within bounds for this change.

ops-bot: KV warm scheduled: 21:05 PT on prod canary. Command:```./ops/kv_warm --model=cutchain:20260321a --prefix-file=infra/common_prefixes.txt```

kevin: Rollback plan: revert to cutchain:20260318z (current prod) using `tools/deploy rollback --to=cutchain:20260318z` . No DB migrations. Abort criteria: error rate > 2% sustained for 2m or p95 latency > 220ms.

maria: QA: please +1 if you see nothing blocking after warm. Also tagging @kevin for oncall.

david: Smoke pass on basic prompts. Long-chat OK after second run. +1.

jia: KV warm looks good, hit rate ~90% on common prefixes. Signs good, approving staged promote. :thumbsup:

maria: @deploy-bot please pin artifact and create staged promo job for 21:15 PT. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100%, 5m between steps. Abort on error spike or latency regressions per kevin's criteria.

deploy-bot: Pinning artifact and scheduling promotion job. Job id: promo-1742601234-1
Pinned artifact: gcr.io/redwood/cutchain:20260321a
Promotion plan:
- step1: 10% at 21:15 PT
- step2: 50% at 21:20 PT
- step3: 100% at 21:25 PT
Manual proceed at each step. Logs and metrics posted to https://dashboards.internal/releases/promo-1742601234-1

ops-bot: Rollback ticket created: RN-8724. Oncall pinged: @kevin @jia. Slack alert channel set: #promo-1742601234-watchers

kevin: I'll be watching the error-rate and p95. Will trigger rollback if errors >1.5% sustained for 2min.

deploy-bot: Promotion started — step1 (10%) -> completed. Metrics snapshot: p95 latency 142ms, errors 0.4%, KV hit 91%.

maria: Proceed to step2.

deploy-bot: step2 (50%) -> completed. Metrics snapshot: p95 160ms, errors 0.9%. No backend spikes.

jia: Noticing a small reranker flake in one shard but single-instance; not systemic. Proceed.

deploy-bot: step3 (100%) -> completed. All traffic now on cutchain:20260321a. Post-deploy checks: KV warmness 92%, rolling error rate 0.6%, p95 168ms. No elevated alerts.

david: Merging release-notes PR and tagging docs.

maria: Great work — thanks team. Closing promo thread. :tada: If anything shows up, reopen RN-8724.

deploy-bot: Promo job promo-1742601234-1 finished: SUCCESS. Artifacts pinned to prod slots. Audit log: https://audit.internal/releases/1742601234

kevin: I'll keep an eye on overnight dashboards; handoff to night ops in 30m.

jia: Approved final. Good ship. :shipit:
